description: 资源与角色置换控制下的三资源双 token 序列协议形成
research_question: 当每个资源 sender 连续发送两个 token 时，第二个 token 是否携带可复用的信息；资源槽位置换和伙伴覆盖如何影响序列形成、组合功能与跨主体一致性？

protocol.message_order: resource0_token0, resource0_token1, resource1_token0, resource1_token1, resource2_token0, resource2_token1
protocol.receiver_evaluation: unique six-token codes observed on the 120-map test table are materialized exactly; unobserved rows are not needed for the reported behavioral metrics

training.new_communication_heads: fresh random sender and receiver modules

measurements.sequence_test: token0 and token1 are sampled autoregressively; conditional token1 probabilities are recorded for every possible token0 prefix

controls_and_limits: canonical and cyclic resource assignments move the resource identity across architectural slots while keeping the world geometry fixed
the three topology schedules reproduce the v0.39 partner-coverage manipulation
a six-token tuple tests within-sender sequential structure and multi-resource composition, not open-ended natural language
the policy-gradient update is shared and centralized
